parameters.prompt: One continuous fixed-camera, eye-level shot. The man in the reference image speaks the supplied audio as a relaxed conversation with one person. Preserve his face, clear glasses, navy shirt, study and soft daylight. His jaw moves freely on vowels and his lips close naturally for consonants and pauses, without a held smile or clenched teeth. His shoulders and hands rest. Small head adjustments are separated by stillness, not rhythmic nodding or side-to-side swaying. He inclines forward slightly once as he begins the viewing promise, then settles with steady eye contact through the final one-number point. Natural blinks and restrained expressions. No finger pointing, added text, camera movement, cuts or extra speech. Finish in a relaxed, settled pose.

final_soundtrack_policy: Use the unchanged original15-second narration; the appended zero samples are only a generation handle. Trim excess picture after15seconds without retiming.
supersedes_for_this_request: r21-buyer-and-emphasis/PERFORMANCE-REPAIR-PROPOSAL.md; user now accepts lip-sync timing and requests articulation/head-performance changes, not a new voice take.
stopping_conditions: No paid submission or new input upload before separate authorization.
Reverify price, compatible duration and expected charge before submission; stop if the cap is exceeded or cannot be bounded.
Stop after one submission, including failure or an uncertain result. No automatic retry or additional correction call.
No top-up, credit purchase, paid overage, narration generation or account changes.
Reject insufficient picture duration, changed speech timing, identity drift, repeated gesturing, hallucinated text or restricted/exaggerated articulation.
No freeze, replay, retime or automatic lip-sync repair to rescue a failed take.
Integrate only into a new private preview after audiovisual review. R22 and the canonical narration remain unchanged.
